By now, the pattern is clear: Trump issues these messages when he is frustrated over his lack of control and responds by pretending to be in control.

He can't gain control through military action, and Tehran is ensuring that diplomacy doesn't lend him the pretence of control.

None of this would have happened if Trump didn't listen to Israel in the first place.
